verdict.rationale: There is no documented bulk-export feature or exit path; the migration guides only move data into Loops. Some data can be pulled out programmatically: the official MCP server can read contacts, events, and content, and a public REST API with an OpenAPI spec is available. Leaving would mean building your own extraction through the API or MCP. Missing for 10: a documented full-account export (contacts, lists, events, campaigns, workflows, templates), stated open export formats such as CSV/JSON/HTML for email content, outbound migration guidance, and independent confirmation that data can be fully extracted.
